description: Your restaurant's quarterly food cost analysis requires price updates and the introduction of a new premium tier. First, update the prices of three existing menu items: change 'HAMMER COFFEE' from its current $2.00 to $3.75, change 'SMK HOUS B FAST' to $10.50, and change 'OLD TIMER B FAST' to $9.75. Then create a new menu category called 'PREMIUM SELECTIONS' and add three new items to it: 'WAGYU BEEF BURGER' at $24.95, 'TRUFFLE FRIES' at $12.95, and 'ARTISAN CHEESE PLATE' at $18.50. Back Office PIN is 1111. When the 'ENTER SECRET KEY' dialog appears, leave the field empty and click OK.
